build_crowdhuman_evaluator: build a CrowdHumanMetric evaluator to compute AP, MR, and JI metrics for person detection results
test_results2json: test the results2json method to convert detection results into CrowdHuman JSON format
run_eval_ap: run the eval_ap static method to calculate average precision from a score list and ground truth count
run_eval_mr: run the eval_mr method to compute Caltech-style log-average miss rate from detection scores
run_eval_ji: run the eval_ji method to evaluate Jaccard Index using multiprocessing across detection samples
